co2-extract-yvh.name: CO2 hop extract
co2-extract-yvh.notes: Non-isomerized lupulin extract. Each can is labelled with its alpha; 1 mL is about 10 IBU in 5 gal of 1.050 boiled 60 min. Variety-specific low-pressure extracts (e.g. Citra CO2 at 53.2%) keep more oil and are dosed in the whirlpool for aroma.

cryo-ahtanum.name: Cryo Ahtanum
cryo-ahtanum.notes: Lupulin concentrate. Yakima Chief 2022 crop. Alpha is the midpoint of the published range; the lot CoA overrides it. Substitute at 40-50 % of T-90 by weight. Late kettle, knockout, whirlpool or dry hop.

dynaboost.name: DynaBoost
dynaboost.notes: Whirlpool flowable extract (formerly YCH 702). Typical dose 0.2-0.5 g/L; dilute 1:10 before dosing. YCH expects bitter pickup in the whirlpool to be negligible, so its primary use is flavour.

flex.name: Flex
flex.notes: Flowable lupulin extract targeted at 65% alpha, dosed early in the kettle. No vegetative matter, so the extract form scalar applies and the resin still needs the boil to isomerize.

hop-shot.name: Hop Shot
hop-shot.notes: Non-isomerized lupulin extract sold in 10 mL syringes. Boil only. 1 mL is about 10 IBU in 5 gal of 1.050 boiled 60 min. Columbus, Centennial, Cascade/Willamette, and two blends (Cluster/Magnum) that carry no variety.

incognito.name: Incognito
incognito.notes: Whirlpool flowable extract. Dose 0.5-2.0 g/L with a 2.0 g/L maximum; 1 g is roughly 1 mL. Haas publishes a 1:6 T-90 replacement, which is more generous than the cooling curve prices it; see docs/hops/hop-products.md section 5.

lupomax-amarillo.name: Lupomax Amarillo
lupomax-amarillo.notes: Lupulin concentrate. BarthHaas 2025 sell sheet. The lot CoA overrides the preset. Substitute at 50-70 % of T-90 by weight. Whirlpool, late kettle or dry hop.
